evals.name: fetch-known-cs-ticket
evals.prompt: Fetch the full details of CS-43404 using the Jira skill
evals.expected_output: Structured output with 10 sections including basic info (Squad: FinTech, Priority: P1-Critical, Status: Confirmed), customer info, ADF-extracted descriptions, related issues (DES-761, FIN-6100), attachments, and comments

assertions.name: has-basic-info-section
assertions.description: Output includes basic info section header

assertions.name: correct-squad
assertions.description: Squad field correctly extracted as FinTech

assertions.name: has-adf-description
assertions.description: ADF Issue Description extracted to plain text section

evals.name: search-by-keyword
evals.prompt: Search for CS tickets related to 'debit card' using JQL: project = CS AND summary ~ "debit card"
evals.expected_output: Multiple results including CS-43404 and CS-41980, with status, priority, squad, and root cause excerpts for closed tickets

assertions.name: contains-target-ticket
assertions.description: Search results include the known test ticket CS-43404

assertions.name: contains-historical-closed
assertions.description: Search results include historical closed ticket CS-41980

assertions.name: has-root-cause
assertions.description: Closed tickets include root cause excerpts

evals.name: search-by-squad-filter
evals.prompt: Search for recent FinTech CS tickets: project = CS AND cf[10089] = FinTech ORDER BY created DESC, limit 5
evals.expected_output: 5 results, all with [FinTech] squad tag, sorted by creation date descending

assertions.name: all-fintech
assertions.description: No results with missing squad (all should be FinTech)

evals.name: error-invalid-issue-key
evals.expected_output: Error message indicating the issue does not exist or no permission, with non-zero exit code

evals.name: error-malformed-jql
evals.prompt: Search with invalid JQL: project = NONEXISTENT AND summary ~
evals.expected_output: Error message from Jira API about malformed JQL, with non-zero exit code

evals.name: search-pagination-indicator
evals.prompt: Search with small limit to verify pagination: project = CS ORDER BY created DESC, limit 2
evals.expected_output: 2 results with 'more results available' indicator since CS project has 43000+ tickets

assertions.name: has-more-indicator
assertions.description: Pagination indicator shows more results available

evals.name: update-whitelist-rejection
evals.prompt: Try to update CS-43404 with a non-whitelisted field: {"status":"Done"}
evals.expected_output: Error about unknown patch fields, non-zero exit

evals.name: update-empty-patch-rejection
evals.prompt: Try to update CS-43404 with an empty patch: {}
evals.expected_output: Error about needing at least one supported field

evals.name: download-host-rejection
evals.prompt: Try to download from a non-Jira host: https://evil.example.com/malware.png

evals.name: download-invalid-url
evals.prompt: Try to download from an invalid URL: not-a-url

assertions.name: ok-false
assertions.description: Result indicates failure for invalid URL
